response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically strong individual contributor with genuine developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (custom test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD setup), which aligns well with the 'engineering productivity' focus area. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years managing/leading teams, conducting one-on-ones, and setting performance expectations, and his 15+ year career history shows exclusively individual-contributor titles (Software/Senior/Staff Developer) with no evidence of direct reports, hiring, or formal people leadership.
strengths: Deep, hands-on experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (custom test runner 'Trial', assertion library 'Fluent-Asserts', CI/CD setup)
Very broad technical range across languages, platforms (web, mobile, embedded, desktop) and 15+ years of software craftsmanship
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentorship inclination via workshops, talks, and courses (Selenium, TDD, Web Internals)
concerns: No evidence of formal people-management experience (no direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership titles)
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or setting cross-team strategic roadmaps
Mobile platform experience is dated and limited (brief iOS/Apple TV work in 2015-2016) relative to the role's mobile-ecosystem emphasis

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools / testing infrastructure background
No organizational change leadership or strategic roadmap experience
